Not an unexecuted branch: four tests drive the action === 'revoke' arm through banDurationFor and assert on updateUserById's argument - they assert the mutated value because every assertion spells the expectation as the same imported symbol. The restore side IS literally pinned at revoke-admin.test.ts:175; the revoke side is the omission.
